parent_objective: implement no-policy response-history materialization for the M1330/M1331 merged source corpus
blocked_by: M1332 designs materialization but artifacts do not yet exist
supersedes: reusing M1280 materialized histories for the merged source corpus

public_gates: M1333 must not use private holdout
M1333 must preserve actor input contract
M1333 must preserve source_run_id, source_row_id, original_pair_id, and source_identity
M1333 must use source-run-specific fault profiles
M1333 must apply fault params_override values
M1333 must report global friction and halfshaft blockers
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use raw pair_id as source identity
do not use the wrong fault profile
do not hide global friction gap

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes command-response histories for the admissible merged source corpus
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if materialization drops source identity metadata
stop if scenario or fault lookup is incomplete
stop if actor-view history includes metadata or hidden labels
stop if global friction or halfshaft gaps are hidden
fallback_plan: if source lookup fails, add a source-run registry adapter before materialization
if fault profile lookup fails, repair profile dispatch before running a full export
if actor-view cleanliness fails, fix projection before any policy-side objective
if materialization passes, route to result audit before objective tuning or PPO

admission_evidence: M1332 designs source-run identity preserving materialization
allowed_updates: source top-up materialization tool and focused tests
status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: materialized history counts match M1332 expectations
scenario and fault lookups are complete

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1333 materializes offline command-response histories and does not test a deployed actor's closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: create correct-history and same-pair wrong-history artifacts for later policy-side evaluation
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialization fails lookup or cleanliness gates, record the schema failure before any policy training.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A dedicated source-topup response-history materializer can produce clean command-response history and wrong-history swap artifacts for all 366 merged source pairs while preserving source identity metadata.
success_criteria: global friction and halfshaft blockers are reported
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: materialized counts do not match design without clear blocker
scenario or fault lookup is incomplete
source identity metadata is missing or duplicated
actor-view history contains metadata, labels, or hidden physical fields
global friction or halfshaft gaps are hidden
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1333 passes as infrastructure if it materializes clean source-identity-preserving command-response histories for the M1330/M1331 merged corpus without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, hidden blockers, or actor-input expansion.
